source: https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/act/implementations/ and the page of each implementation
method: The index table and the per-implementation pages were parsed from HTML. For each implemented ACT rule: its type (WCAG 2 Rule = approved, Proposed Rule), its consistency (Consistent or Partial), the ACT rule id, and the implementation's own rule ids. The criteria of each ACT rule come from the ACT testcases.json of the same day, with the relation conformance or secondary.
note: The axe-core report uses a canary build with all experimental rules enabled. The counts are what the vendors reported to the W3C.
